# Squares in Squares: validated portfolio

## Purpose and contents
Reusable unit-square packings for all 1,000 competition puzzles. submission.csv contains 500,500 rows, one per square. Coordinates describe square centres; angles are radians. The axis-aligned enclosing side is L. Lower score is better: sum over n=1..1000 of L/sqrt(n)-1. Never mix individual rows from different candidate layouts: replace the complete n-square group.

## How to use
Read per_puzzle.csv to inspect scores and provenance, then filter submission.csv by n and plot its rotated unit squares. Preserve decimal coordinates when copying files. Validate the serialized CSV and its pandas float64 round trip using the official metric before submitting. File hashes and metric identity are recorded in portfolio_manifest.json. Current certified portfolio score is 22.307815883682977 locally. Latest completed submission 57595954 scored 22.3078158836.

## Provenance and credibility
The portfolio combines credited public-provider witnesses, retained local refinements and standard grids. Current per-puzzle lineage is authoritative. The public notebook is https://www.kaggle.com/code/kirilltym/22-3720-cpu-cuda-mps-eda-snap-lp . This is a source notebook, not a newly published notebook by this team. Inherited mathematical witnesses retain original credit; latest uploader is not necessarily discoverer. See SOURCE_NOTICES.md, external_contributors.csv and per_puzzle_contributors.csv. Adoption events measure sequential reuse benefit, not personal authorship or unique causal credit.

## Updates and validation
Monitoring is scheduled every six hours while the local computer and app are running. Versions are event-driven: publish only validated improvements or meaningful documentation changes; daily is the expected metadata cadence, not a guarantee of new solutions each day. Retain previous versions, rejected attempts and attribution. No paid search is implied. The current exported candidates passed raw-decimal and pandas round-trip checks against code matching the fetched official metric.

## License and limitations
Other / mixed source-specific terms: this collection is not blanket relicensed. Apache-2.0 and inherited source conditions are preserved in the supplied license files and notices. Review the original sources before redistribution. Private project dataset. No optimality proof, ranking guarantee, or automatic coauthorship is claimed. Contribution write-up remains a human-review draft.

## Visual diagnostics
See score_overview.png and cumulative_score.png for all 1000 puzzles. Download puzzle_gallery.zip, extract it and open index.html to filter by n or sort by score. priority_puzzles.csv and priority_contact_sheet.png help inspect high-score cases. High score, local outliers and theoretical area-bound ceilings do not establish that a packing can be improved; check mathematical constraints and search cost.
